comments.author: participant1
reporter
comments.body:
I set a job to create index at 4am, insert 1000 entities every 15 min. 

So there was an index building last night, and there will be another one tonight. 

If it is true, why? Is that index out of sync with entities ? 
Should I create indices once all entities are inserted?
Where did the document mention this? 

/assign @participant1 
/unassign

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
you don't need to create index every time after insert. Once you created index for a collection, milvus automatically build index for new inserted data. Besides, milvus will try to compact the small segments to bigger one until the segment size is close to the maxSize(512MB by default), the new compacted segments will be automatically built indices as well. 
Check https://milvus.io/docs/product_faq.md#Can-indexes-be-created-after-inserting-vectors

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
As the stack you offered, most of the cpu is spent on rocksdb.
Milvus will keep send timetick even without any write, and the time tick happens every 200ms per physical chanel
You can either:
1. change MQ implementation to pulsar or kafka
2. reduce the rootCoord.dmlChannelNum to 32 or 64 if you don't have that much collections
